nodes.text: Repeated convergence of multiple non-receipt claims on one depot, with sequential shipments and identical generic warehouse-scan/dock-clerk POD metadata, is a reusable fulfillment-risk signal. It supports coordinated/common-drop-point review but does not by itself prove collusion, theft, or individual customer misconduct; legitimate consolidator or reshipper arrangements remain possible. Assess downstream custody separately; absence of pickup, forwarding, recipient authorization, signature/image, geolocation, or onward-delivery records is an evidence gap and does not prove theft or non-delivery. The same distinction is supported by FND-975c30e719, FND-9c9fbe2972, FND-94e33ac2dd, and FND-2a08dbecf6.
